setNameCorrection.why: UPSTREAM ERROR, NOT OURS. api.tcgdex.net/v2/ja/sets/SV4a returns setName レイジングサーフ (Raging Surf) while returning SV4a's correct release date 2023-12-01 and its correct card count 320. Raging Surf is SV3a: a 92-card set released 2023-09-22, and tcgdex returns that same name for SV3a. Our two manifests therefore carried ONE name for TWO different sets. The ROWS are right — this file holds 367 rows numbered 1-354, which is Shiny Treasure ex's shape, not Raging Surf's 92 — so only the label was wrong. Confirmed against the Japanese market (High Class Pack SV4a シャイニートレジャーex, 2023-12-01).
